status: Post-outcome amendment after external review; not preregistered semantic validation
external_review: Claude Code 2.1.220, actual claude-opus-5-5, authenticated through claude.ai subscription with API-key/helper/provider overrides disabled
review_scope: Claude read code, saved outputs, selected local witnesses and seven images. It did not execute analyses. Codex reviewers inspected Sanskrit records, visual components and recomputed selected arithmetic; their scopes are in subreviews/.
protocol_changes: The original protocol named 17 original anchor codes. The executed BH family expanded to all 596 previously new codes and three positions, because proposals were selected across that larger inventory. Site sensitivity is a separate descriptive calculation, not a new site-stratified permutation sample.

The run-v2 standardized maximum estimated moments from its saved permutations. Diagnostics-v3 uses fixed analytic conditional moments for the same 5,000 arrays, with 1,388 active and 400 deterministic comparisons among the 1,788 declared new-code tests.
Correct site enumeration from every face containing a code, adding 29 summaries across 24 codes without changing the pooled counts.

Check final-only versus terminal-block membership, formula duplication, numeral adjacency and exact-substitution length distributions in a new context diagnostic endpoint. These questions and classes were selected after the review's observations.

Preserve literal lexical matching and add a documented finite Sanskrit join model, rival support rankings and disputed-crosswalk exclusions. This is a bounded sensitivity, not a complete sandhi or linguistic decoder.
New semantic comparison anchors receive dictionary-productivity stress tests; they have no asserted phonetic windows whose meanings could be validated by those controls.

Use direct pictorial vivadha, matya and kaṅkata comparisons alongside functional hypotheses. Later bhāra and kumbha measure senses remain alternatives with no numerical unit transferred to Indus records.
W154, W156 and W158 form a context-tested carrier complex. W617 moves to a lower pictorial/segmentation lead. Display picture and ordering evidence separately.
preservation: Run-v1 through run-v5 and the original review decisions remain unchanged. New diagnostics and viewer runs have distinct paths. Original report and diagnostic code before this review are retained in subreviews/.
deferred_tests: A fitted joint ordering model needs a declared estimation/evaluation design and does not identify meanings by fitting the same selected strings. The present length, partner and formula sensitivities expose that confounding without claiming to remove it.
No new count threshold or step-down family was selected to improve W142's significance. The full-family result is retained with final avoidance and its exact declared reference.
No blinded withheld-family semantic benchmark or newly joined independent archaeological context was available. The candidate predictions identify those future discriminating observations.
